app.description: Sends simple input to the visible Flyff client.
help.key: Press a key, for example W or F1
error.invalid_key: Key: A-Z, 0-9, F1-F12, space, tab, enter, or escape
error.windows_only: This application only works on Windows.
error.no_window: No visible window for {process} was found.
error.focus_failed: The Flyff window could not be focused.
error.input_failed: The input could not be sent: {reason}
ui.title: Flyff Bot
ui.tab_dashboard_tooltip: Monitor live status, kill progress, player vitals, and the camera preview.
ui.tab_combat_targets_tooltip: Configure target monsters, combat verification, and emergency stuck recovery.
ui.tab_vitals_buffs_tooltip: Configure consumable thresholds, hotkeys, and timed power-ups.
ui.tab_navigation_world_tooltip: Manage map profiles, world data, spawn anchors, and the navigation inspector.
ui.tab_diagnostics_logs_tooltip: Inspect session events, target verification, OCR metrics, and placement guides.
error.frame_invalid_window: The Flyff window is no longer valid.
error.frame_minimized: The Flyff window is minimized and cannot be captured.
error.frame_occluded: The Flyff window must be in the foreground before capture.
error.frame_capture_failed: The Flyff window could not be captured.
help.detect_mobs: Capture one frame and detect visible mobs
help.class_name: Class name to include (may be repeated)
error.farm_options_required: Farm mode requires a model, labels, and a target anchor.
error.farm_goal_required: Farm item goals require both an item name and count.
error.farm_template_unreadable: A configured target template could not be read.
help.farm: Run the foreground-safe autonomous farming loop
help.attack_cooldown: Cooldown for each attack key in seconds (default: {default})
help.search_retry: Delay before retrying a mob search in seconds (default: {default})
help.search_idle_timeout: Idle time before staged search begins in seconds (default: {default})
help.search_rotation_duration: Camera rotation pulse duration in seconds (default: {default})
help.search_settle_pause: Observation pause duration between camera search pulses in seconds (default: {default})
help.search_movement_duration: Exploration movement pulse duration in seconds (default: {default})
help.navigation_map: Path to the learned navigation map and spawn heatmap (default: {default})
help.goal_item: Item name required to complete the farm goal
help.goal_count: Item quantity required to complete the farm goal
help.target_name: Whitelisted target monster name accepted by the target header (may be repeated)
status.farm_started: Farming started; hold END to stop.
help.validate_mob_dataset: Validate the mob YOLO dataset without accessing the game client
help.train_mob_detector: Train and export the custom mob YOLO detector
status.training_complete: Mob detector exported to {model}; labels written to {labels}
ui.attack_key_tooltip: Click, then press a supported attack key (A-Z, 0-9, F1-F12, or Space).
ui.attack_key_unsupported: Unsupported attack key. Choose A-Z, 0-9, F1-F12, or Space.
ui.align_camera_tooltip: Zoom the camera out to its hard stop and set the standardized 45 degree pitch.
ui.auto_align_camera_tooltip: Run the camera alignment as a pre-flight step before each farming session.
ui.camera_preview_tooltip: Show or hide the latest read-only game-client frame and perception annotations.
ui.profile_reset_prompt: Are you sure you want to reset the current navigation map? Unsaved changes will be lost.
ui.profile_load_error_prompt: The selected map profile could not be loaded: {reason}
ui.profile_anchor_anchored: Profile anchored: the map is being learned
ui.profile_anchor_read_only: Profile read-only: it could not be re-anchored, so nothing is learned
ui.profile_anchor_unanchored: Profile without an anchor: it was saved without a position fix and will load read-only
ui.profile_unmatched_prompt: The minimap around the character does not match the one this profile was recorded at, so its routes and spawn hotspots cannot be placed. Load it read-only to follow its routes without learning anything, or cancel and move closer to where the profile was recorded.
ui.profile_scale_mismatch_title: Profile Recorded At Another Zoom Level
ui.profile_scale_mismatch_prompt: This profile was recorded at minimap scale {stored}, while the client currently shows scale {live}. Its distances mean something different at that scale, so it was not loaded. Restore the minimap zoom level it was recorded at and try again.
ui.powerups_hotkey_tooltip: Action slot key pressed when this timer expires.
ui.powerups_interval_tooltip: Seconds between two presses. The first press happens after one full interval.
ui.powerups_active_tooltip: Disable this entry without deleting it.
ui.powerups_empty: No power-ups configured. Timed hotkeys are only pressed while a session is running.
ui.target_grace_tooltip: Time to wait for the target header to appear before retrying. Prevents accidental double-click walking.
ui.kill_verification_tooltip: Use the in-game Monster Kills counter to confirm kills instead of relying solely on target bar disappearance.
ui.recovery_timeout_tooltip: How long the character may make no progress at all before the emergency teleport hotkey is pressed.
ui.recovery_hotkey_tooltip: Quickslot key holding the teleport item or skill, for example a Town Blinkwing. Without a key the session pauses instead of teleporting.
ui.recovery_spawn_point_tooltip: Store the current position as the town or respawn anchor this map's emergency teleport arrives at.
ui.recovery_spawn_point_refused_prompt: The current position is not measured, so it cannot be stored as a spawn point. Make the minimap readable and try again.
ui.anchor_threshold_tooltip: Minimum template match score required to accept the target header. Lower it when a selected target is reported as no target.
ui.placements_tooltip: Show transparent in-game guides for the HUD areas used by vitals and OCR readers.
ui.target_debug_name_not_evaluated: Not evaluated without a target header
ui.target_debug_reason_hp: HP bar below minimum pixel threshold
ui.target_debug_reason_name: No whitelisted monster name was recognized
ui.target_debug_reason_name_unreadable: No readable text was found in the target name area
ui.target_debug_reason_name_ocr_failed: Text recognition of the target name failed
ui.target_debug_reason_name_engine: Tesseract OCR is unavailable, so the target name cannot be verified
ui.target_debug_break_acquisition: The clicked target was never confirmed, so its location is on cooldown.
ui.target_debug_break_unverified: The target header disappeared during the fight, so the engagement was aborted.
ui.target_debug_break_timeout: The fight made no progress within the engagement timeout, so it was aborted.
ui.target_debug_break_obstacle: The approach ran against an obstacle, so the engagement was aborted.
ui.monster_stats_debug_anchor_fixed_regi: No anchor template loaded; the predefined placement region is read
ui.monster_stats_debug_status_engine_una: Tesseract OCR is not installed or cannot be started
ui.monster_stats_debug_status_no_match: No kill counter found in the text
ui.targets_active_tooltip: Hunt this monster; with no monster active every detected monster stays eligible.
ui.targets_quota_tooltip: Kills required before this monster is dropped from targeting; zero farms it without a limit.
ui.targets_empty: No detection model loaded, so no monster classes are available.
ui.targets_close_client: Close the game client once every quota is reached
ui.targets_close_client_tooltip: Asks the client window to close itself when the session completes; the game may still refuse.
ui.world_data_tooltip: Extract client regions and arm vector navigation for farming goals.
ui.world_data_result: {world}: {zones} spawn zones, {obstacles} impassable areas, {blocks} terrain blocks, monster classes: {monsters}. Saved to {path}.
ui.world_data_no_regions: No client region was found under {path}.
ui.world_data_scale_tooltip: Provisional calibration value: the client displays no run speed from which this scale could be measured.
ui.world_data_quota_tooltip: 0 means unlimited. When the quota is reached the bot moves to the next spawn zone of the next unfinished monster.
ui.world_data_active: Vector navigation active: {world}, anchored to a {monster} zone.
ui.world_data_inactive: Vector navigation deactivated. The session uses the learned map again.
help.extract_world: Extract client world geometry and terrain height fields offline
help.client_world_root: Path to the client's world directory (default: {default})
help.world_map_directory: Directory the extracted world maps are written to (default: {default})
help.world_region: Restrict extraction to one client region; repeat for several
status.world_extracted: {world}: {blocks} of {declared} terrain blocks, {zones} spawn zones, {obstacles} impassable areas -> {path}
status.world_archive_index_skipped: {world}: the packed archive index of {detail} uses an unsupported layout and was skipped
status.world_archive_block_skipped: {world}: the packed terrain block {detail} could not be decoded and was skipped
error.world_extraction_no_regions: No client region with a world script was found under {root}
ui.world_data_warnings: {count} parts of this region could not be read and were skipped.
status.world_object_file_skipped: {world}: the placed-object file {detail} uses an unsupported record layout and was skipped
